title: Content Safety Review Report
description: A report documenting pre-release testing of a generative content feature against context-specific prompt categories, including any identified conflicts between safety/fairness adjustments and factual accuracy, and the outcome of a staged rollout.
evidence_description: A report enumerating the prompt categories tested before release of a generative content feature, findings for each category (including any factual-accuracy vs. safety/fairness tension identified), remediations applied, and results from the limited-audience staged-rollout phase.
collection_method: Structured pre-release testing conducted by the product/safety team, combined with monitoring data from the staged-rollout phase.
retention_period: Minimum 3 years, and retained for the lifetime of the feature version tested.
artifact_format: PDF report; per-category test results retained as structured data.
